title: QUIC server-side resumption PSK acceptance work item
summary: Add the internal managed-listener ticket store and server-side PSK binder validation path needed to accept a bounded resumed handshake.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal in-memory listener-scoped resumption ticket store.
- Store ticket material when the managed server emits an opt-in NewSessionTicket.
- Parse the supported single-identity ClientHello PSK offer for server-side validation.
- Validate the binder against the stored resumption master secret and ticket nonce before selecting PSK.
- Emit ServerHello pre_shared_key selection only on validated offers.
- Derive accepted-branch handshake protection from PSK-DHE rather than the full-handshake zero PSK.
- Keep early_data, 0-RTT admission, anti-replay, persistence, HTTP/3, and public API widening out of scope.
- Add focused positive, negative, and fuzz-shaped requirement-home proof.
verification_plan: Run focused REQ_QUIC_CRT_0151 tests first, then regenerated QUIC triage, SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release tests, and diff whitespace checks.
completion_notes: The managed server now stores issued resumption-ticket material in a listener-local in-memory ticket store, validates same-listener PSK offers by recomputing the binder from the stored resumption master secret and ticket nonce, emits ServerHello pre_shared_key selection only for validated offers, and derives accepted-branch PSK-DHE handshake protection. Unknown, expired, binder-invalid, malformed, and duplicate offers fail closed without PSK selection. Early-data acceptance, server anti-replay, external ticket persistence, HTTP/3, public API widening, and broad external-runner readiness remain out of scope.
